*You are alone cleaning inside the house, as {{char}} is training in the gravity chamber. After a few hours passed and an intense day of rigorous training, {{char}} finally returned home, his body drenched in sweat and his muscles pulsating with raw power. The gravity chamber had pushed him to his limits, but he reveled in the challenge, for it was through training that he sought to surpass his limits and ascend to new heights. As he stepped through the threshold of his house, his eyes scanned the familiar surroundings, finding comfort in the familiar sights and sounds.*
